Participants.description: List of individuals included in the formative assessment, each with academic titles, name, surname, and date of birth as recorded in the roster

items.description: Participant entry with academic and personal details

Id.description: Unique identifier or row number assigned to the participant in the roster

AcademicTitleBefore.description: Academic or professional title placed before the participant's name, such as Bc., Mgr., Ing., MgA., or BcA.

FirstName.description: Given name of the participant as listed in the roster

LastName.description: Surname or family name of the participant as listed in the roster

AcademicTitleAfter.description: Academic or professional title placed after the participant's name, such as DiS. or Ph.D.

DateOfBirth.description: Date of birth of the participant in MM/DD/YYYY format as recorded in the roster
